business_context: Legacy modernization migrating on-premises Mainframe and Ab Initio workflows to AWS. Heavy pipeline degradation caused by full-table merge patterns and severe data skew across multi-billion-row financial transaction tables.
summary_angle: Data Engineer specializing in legacy-to-cloud migration and large-scale Spark optimization for regulated financial data

phase_1_ingestion.daily_activity: Decoupling legacy Ab Initio ETL graphs by authoring custom Python ingestion services that stream on-premise transactional and compliance data to the cloud.

phase_2_storage.daily_activity: Structuring multi-tiered Bronze, Silver, and Gold storage layers and registering metadata for seamless enterprise discovery.
swappable_categories: Metadata & Catalogs (Unity Catalog, Apache Atlas, Alation, Google Dataplex)

phase_3_transformation.daily_activity: Diagnosing cluster bottlenecks using Spark UI, mitigating data skew on multi-billion-row tables using data salting, AQE, and Broadcast Hash Joins, and replacing full merges with partition-aware anti-joins.
key_optimizations: Resolved data skew via data salting and Broadcast Hash Joins
Enabled Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) and Dynamic Partition Pruning (DPP)
Replaced full-table merges with partition-aware anti-join and append patterns

phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.daily_activity: Modeling dimensional schemas and materialized views for financial crime analytics, orchestrating Airflow DAGs, and maintaining automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.

phase_5_serving_and_bi.daily_activity: Building compliance dashboards and analytical models for commercial stakeholders and regulatory audits.
